app.name: Applications Tracker

validation.url: Must start with http:// or https://

loadError.title: Couldn’t load this
loadError.description: Check your connection and try again.

applications.companyPlaceholder: Search or type a new company
applications.jobDescriptionPlaceholder: Paste the text of the job posting here
applications.deleteConfirm: It will be deleted for good. To just hide it from the list, archive it.
applications.undoLastConfirm: That change will be removed from the history and the application will go back to its previous status.
applications.emptyDescription: Add the first one and follow how it moves forward from here.
applications.notFound: This application doesn’t exist or was deleted.

auth.signInSubtitle: Pick up your applications where you left off.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Log every application and follow how it moves forward.

validation.emailInvalid: The email format is not valid

errors.emailRejected: This email is not valid or is already registered
errors.passwordPolicy: The password must be at least 8 characters long and include letters and numbers
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Recover your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If there is an account with {{email}}, we have sent it a link to choose a new password. It expires in 1 hour; if you don’t see it, check your spam folder.
forgotPassword.unavailable: This installation doesn’t send emails, so the password can’t be recovered from here. Ask whoever runs it for help.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Saving it signs you out of every open session.
resetPassword.success: Password saved. Sign in with the new one.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link isn’t valid: it was already used, it expired or it is incomplete. Each link works only once.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Confirming your email protects your account and enables the features that need it.
verifyEmail.success: Email verified. You can now use every feature.
verifyEmail.invalidLink: This link isn’t valid: it was already used, it expired or it is incomplete. If your email is not verified yet, request another one from the notice in the application.
verifyEmail.banner: Confirm your email: when you signed up we sent a link to {{email}}.
verifyEmail.bannerResent: Link sent again to {{email}}. It expires in 24 hours; if you don’t see it, check your spam folder.

fields.staleAfterDays: Flag applications with no activity after (days)

validation.staleAfterDays: Must be a number between 1 and 90

timezone.placeholder: Search for a city or region
timezone.description: It is detected from your browser when you sign in. Change it if it isn’t yours.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Your account and all your data will be permanently deleted: applications with their history, companies, interviews, reminders and documents. To keep them, export your applications to CSV from <link>Applications</link> first and download any PDFs you want to keep: they are not in the CSV.
delete.dialogDescription: This can't be undone. All your data will be deleted and you'll be signed out.

password.title: Password
password.description: We will send {{email}} a link to choose a new password. Saving it signs you out of every session, this one included.
password.sent: Link sent to {{email}}. It expires in 1 hour; if you don’t see it, check your spam folder.
password.unavailable: This installation doesn’t send emails, so the password can’t be changed from here. Ask whoever runs it for help.

email.title: Email
email.pending: Confirm this email is yours with the link we sent when you signed up. If you can’t find it or it expired, request another one.
email.unavailable: This installation doesn’t send emails, so the email can’t be verified from here.

nav.theme: Switch between light and dark theme

companies.title: Companies
companies.deleteInUse: It cannot be deleted: it has {{count}} application(s), archived ones included. Delete them or move them to another company first.
companies.emptyDescription: They are created when you add an application, or you can add them here.

interviews.empty: No interviews yet for this application.

reminders.empty: No pending reminders for this application.
reminders.emptyPendingDescription: Create one so you don’t forget the next step of an application.
reminders.deleteConfirm: It will be deleted for good. Deleting done or dismissed reminders frees up room in your account limit.

responseRate.title: Response rate
responseRate.description: {{reached}} of {{sent}} sent applications reached screening or beyond
responseRate.insufficientData: Not enough data: fewer than {{min}} applications sent ({{sent}})

staleApplications.title: No activity
staleApplications.empty: No application has gone more than {{days}} days without activity.

welcome.title: Start by adding your first application
welcome.description: This is where you’ll see how many applications you have, where each one stands and what’s pending.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Your CVs and cover letters as PDFs.
documents.emptyTitle: You don’t have any documents yet

documents.emptyFiltered: There are no documents of this type.
documents.emptyArchived: There are no matching archived documents.

usage.none: It has not been sent in any application.

documents.deleteConfirm: “{{name}}” and its PDF will be deleted, and its space freed up. This cannot be undone. If you only want to take it out of the library, archive it.
documents.deleteInUse_one: “{{name}}” was sent in {{count}} application: deleting it would lose what you sent. You can archive it to take it out of the library.
documents.deleteInUse_other: “{{name}}” was sent in {{count}} applications: deleting it would lose what you sent. You can archive it to take it out of the library.

viewer.notFound: This document is no longer available
viewer.fallback: If your browser doesn’t show the PDF here, download it.

validation.notPdf: The file must be a PDF
validation.tooLarge: The file is over the maximum size

failure.render_failed: The CV could not be laid out. Try again; if it keeps failing, try another design.
failure.storage_limit_reached: The PDF did not fit in your storage. Free up some space and try again.

generate.title: Generate a CV from your profile
generate.description: Choose the design and what to include. The CV keeps your profile as it is now: editing it later will not change this CV.
generate.notAtsWarning: This design is eye-catching, but it uses two columns: applicant tracking systems (ATS) may read it out of order. Use it when a person will read the CV.
generate.languageHint: Only the fixed headings ("Experience", "Education"…) are translated. Your content appears as you wrote it.
generate.emptyProfile: Your profile is still empty: the CV would only have your contact details. Fill in your profile to make the most of it.
generate.started: Generating your CV. It will appear in Documents in a few seconds.

usage.title: Account usage
usage.description: How much of each limit of your account you have used. They don’t renew: you free up room by deleting applications, companies, reminders or documents. Archiving an application or a document, or completing a reminder, doesn’t free up room.

notifications.description: Choose what you want to hear about by email. Every email has a link to turn that notification off.

notify_weekly_digest.description: On Monday mornings: pending items, this week's interviews and stalled applications.
